Comparison brief: Marlstone Edge vs Pinecrest Edge
evidence_dose=0 (positive ⇒ more points favour Marlstone Edge)

- p1: cache hit ratio: Marlstone Edge=0.962 ← better | Pinecrest Edge=0.938
- p2: PoP count: Marlstone Edge=245  | Pinecrest Edge=310 ← better
- p3: TLS handshake p95 (ms): Marlstone Edge=38 ← better | Pinecrest Edge=52
- p4: egress cost ($/TB): Marlstone Edge=55  | Pinecrest Edge=41 ← better
- p5: purge propagation (s): Marlstone Edge=4 ← better | Pinecrest Edge=9
- p6: origin shield offload: Marlstone Edge=0.79  | Pinecrest Edge=0.88 ← better
- p7: config rollout time (min): Marlstone Edge=3 ← better | Pinecrest Edge=7
- p8: annual availability (%): Marlstone Edge=99.951  | Pinecrest Edge=99.985 ← better

Tally: Marlstone Edge better on 4/8; Pinecrest Edge better on 4/8.
